question: Where’s the closest restaurant when heading north from Lander Trail, Afton, WY?
sql: WITH start_location AS ( SELECT ST_Centroid(r.geometry)::geography AS geom FROM roads AS r WHERE r.road_name ILIKE '%Lander Trail%' AND ST_Intersects(r.geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Afton%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, start_location AS sl WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ( (degrees(ST_Azimuth(sl.geom, p.geometry::geography)) >= 0 AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(sl.geom, p.geometry::geography)) <= 22.5) OR (degrees(ST_Azimuth(sl.geom, p.geometry::geography)) >= 337.5 AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(sl.geom, p.geometry::geography)) <= 360) ) ORDER BY ST_Distance(sl.geom, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
